fixtures.objective: Keep the classroom ward intact while students evacuate.
fixtures.threat: Three cracks are spreading across the ward boundary.
fixtures.situation: The ward is unstable but no hostile creature is present.

consequence_frame.success: The chosen circuit slows the cracks and preserves the evacuation route.
consequence_frame.cost: Mana and selected Vault or Stock resources are consumed only after confirmation.
